The only additional source you may read is `@ANCHOR@`. It is
an explicitly allowlisted, read-only shared base case. Never modify it. Copy
only the files needed into this job's exclusive work directory.
Preserve its scene, animation, environment, timing, and all organization/group
invariants, changing only the intended factor expressed by application,
subtype, variant, and prompt.

guidance.scene: For scene/world editing, preserve camera, animation, timing, and all unaffected assets; apply only the requested environment or scene edit.
guidance.robot: For robotics simulation or embodiment pairs, preserve the task, world, object layout, action timing, and camera; change only the specified robot embodiment or manipulation factor.
guidance.trajectory: For trajectory variation, preserve subject, scene, action, timing, and camera unless camera path is the named factor; alter only the requested trajectory.

preservation.scene:
Preserve every unrelated source file and world property: camera controller and
trajectory, room geometry outside the target edit, all other object transforms,
materials, lighting, animation timing, and rendering settings. Do not redesign
or beautify the scene. Leave `case/camera_trajectory.json` byte-for-byte
unchanged; the pipeline rejects a camera mismatch.
preservation.robot:
Preserve the cloned environment, object transforms, obstacles, start and goal,
navigation curve, speed profile, animation timing, camera controller, camera
trajectory, lighting, materials, and every non-agent entity. Environment or camera refinements are forbidden, even if they appear visually preferable. Leave `case/camera_trajectory.json` byte-for-byte unchanged.
preservation.trajectory:
## Strict navigation trajectory replacement

This workspace has already been populated as a literal clone of the paired
path Anchor codebase at `@ANCHOR@`. Preserve the robot entity, geometry,
materials, articulation, gait implementation, environment, obstacle and target
transforms, lighting, camera controller, camera trajectory, start state, goal
state, and event timing.

Modify only the navigation path definition (for example spline control points
or waypoints) and the minimum directly path-dependent heading/distance
parameterization required to follow it. Do not move obstacles or targets, alter
the robot, change the camera, or redesign any source file. Leave
`case/camera_trajectory.json` byte-for-byte unchanged; the pipeline rejects a
camera mismatch.
